title: MHG Commercial Joins eXp Commercial With $435M in Volume
summary: Top-ranked Phoenix team MHG Commercial joins eXp Commercial, bringing 18 advisors and $435M in volume. Read how they plan to expand nationwide.
body_markdown:
************Top-ranked Phoenix team led by Aaron Dutcher, whose career volume tops $1.3 billion, is taking its practice nationwide************


**BELLINGHAM, Wash. — October 29, 2026 —** eXp Commercial, a nationwide cloud-based commercial real estate brokerage and subsidiary of AGNT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AGNT), today announced that MHG Commercial, previously a commercial team of My Home Group, has joined the company. The 18-advisor Phoenix team brings nearly $435 million in sales and leasing transactions and a clear goal: serve clients wherever their business goes.


“You don’t close $435 million in sales by accident,” said Leo Pareja, CEO of AGNT, Inc. “Aaron, Nick and Carla built one of Arizona’s strongest commercial teams the hard way. Now they want to keep growing without anyone drawing lines around where they can work and service their clients. That’s exactly who eXp Commercial is built for.”


MHG Commercial represents owners, investors, and tenants across office, industrial, retail, multifamily, and land throughout Arizona. *Ranking Arizona* , published by AZ Big Media, ranked MHG Commercial No. 5 among Arizona commercial brokerages with 41 or fewer brokers for 2025.


“I’ve been doing this in Arizona for more than 20 years, and what I care about most is that our people never have to hand off a client,” said Dutcher. “If one of our clients opens a location in Texas or Florida, we want to be the ones in the room. At eXp Commercial, our advisors keep those relationships wherever they lead, and we get to keep building MHG Commercial the way we always have.”


The firm is led by three partners. Aaron Dutcher, a fifth-generation Arizonan, has spent more than two decades in real estate sales and leasing as an investor, business owner, and broker. He has twice been named Commercial Broker of the Year by the *Arizona Journal of Real Estate & Business* . Nicholas Skogen, VP of Sales & Leasing and CFO, began investing in real estate in 2013 and has been licensed since 2017. Carla Magee, COO and a commercial investment specialist, holds an MBA and brings corporate finance experience from Boeing and Microsoft.


With eXp Commercial, MHG Commercial’s advisors can follow their clients into any market, without handing off the relationship or leaving their team behind.


**About AGNT, Inc.**


AGNT, Inc. (Nasdaq: AGNT) is the holding company for eXp Commercial, a nationwide cloud-based commercial real estate brokerage. As a publicly traded company, it offers commercial advisors the unique opportunity to earn equity awards for meeting production goals and driving company growth. With advanced technology and a global network, eXp Commercial helps advisors grow their businesses and serve clients across commercial sectors like office, industrial, retail, multifamily, land, specialty properties and more. Learn more at https://www.expcommercial.com/ and https://expworldholdings.com.
